item.title: Twenty Letters: The Bank of England, the 2% Target, and Seven Years of Missing It
item.description: UK prices are up 32% since December 2019, a 4.3% annual compound rate against a 2% target. What the Governor's twenty open letters blamed, what they forecast, and what the money supply was saying all along.
